rules.threshold: Otsu's threshold on the healthy reference's whole-cell means of the marker (256 bins of width 1 on 0-255): the first split maximising the between-class variance; a cell is positive when its mean is at or above it. The same value is applied to every participant and every measurement condition.
rules.population: Cells positive for the population marker as whole cells; frozen for every measurement condition.
rules.home: Cells positive for the marker as whole cells and not positive for the population marker.
rules.bordering: Two cells border when a pixel of one lies within 2 px of a pixel of the other along a row or a column of the segmentation mask, so a one-pixel background gap between cells still counts.
rules.expectation: Closed form. A condition keeping k of a cell's n pixels is compared with k pixels drawn at random: their mean has the whole-cell mean m and variance s^2 / k x (n - k) / (n - 1), with s^2 the whole-cell pixel variance, and reaches the threshold t with probability Phi((m - t) / sd) (1 or 0 when sd = 0; 0 when k = 0). Expected share: the mean of that probability over the population.
rules.label: Gates: at least 20 population cells and 10 of them positive for the marker as whole cells, else insufficient evidence. Segmentation-sensitive: under one stricter condition the observed share O is below the expectation E x 2^-0.5. Otherwise stable.
rules.caveat: Eroding a cell also removes genuine membrane signal, which random pixel loss does not model; compare the bordering-home shares of excluded and retained cells before reading an excess drop as spillover.
